analysis:
No concrete security regression in the supplied changes. They are limited to CI workflow wiring, Makefile test targets, a changelog fragment and a payout test.

integration.yml: the exact-cache lane (head lines 290-291) sets DARKBLOOM_CBV2_KV_QUANTIZATION and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_CHECKPOINT_QUANTIZATION to native. The smoke lane (head lines 320-342) now fails if either variable is set and expects KV backend 'auto' instead of 'contiguous'. This is test-only, so it adds no runtime attack surface. The weaker assertion (any usable backend) only reduces CI regression detection. Secrets handling is unchanged: HF_READ_TOKEN is used only on push and PRs download without auth. Action pins and the coverage upload are unchanged.

Makefile: provider-test now runs scripts/test-stage-swiftpm-resource-bundles.py, and benchmark-wrapper-test adds three benchmark and report Python tests. These are build and test only, with no production path.

changelog.d/native-inference-quantized-checkpoints.md: it describes a behavioural change in the provider. Default live attention becomes native, and encrypted checkpoint rows get a balanced (lossy) storage encoding with new layout and profile identities that reject incompatible data. This touches the T-041 SSD prefix-cache surface (A-001). The provider source for it is not in this batch, so I could not check that HMAC lookup names, AAD, the KEK chain, salt scoping and the 30-minute TTL are unchanged. The next pass should check that the conversion code adds no prompt-derived plaintext metadata, that layout/profile identity is authenticated in the AAD, and that an incompatible-row rejection falls back to recompute without leaking cross-scope data.

global_payouts_queue_test.go: it only adds a state setup and a second sync call that asserts no duplicate submission. This is a test and consistent with the payout idempotency intent. The payout code itself is not in this batch.

Coverage limit: no provider or coordinator source changed in the supplied units. The changelog describes provider changes whose code was not reviewed.
